card.name: "to" in solution color ranges
card.fires_on: The word "to" joining two color terms in a description of an injection or solution's appearance, as in "colorless to pale yellow".

modes.label: Color range in appearance
modes.description: "to" sits between a first color word and a second, usually lighter or paler, color before the word solution.
modes.example: Argatroban Injection is a clear, colorless<< to>> pale yellow solution.

card.plain: It marks the word "to" in a color range like "colorless to slightly yellow" when a liquid drug is described.
